Title: DETRs Beat YOLOs on Real-time Object Detection
Core_Mechanism: Efficient Hybrid Encoder (AIFI on P5 + CCFM on P3-P5), Top-300 Query Selection, Deformable Decoder
Key_Metrics: COCO R18: 46.5 AP; DUT-Anti-UAV R18: mAP50=0.966, mAP75=0.816, mAP50:95=0.707, AP_small=0.598
Limitations_for_DUT_Anti_UAV: Discards P2/4 high-res features; nearest upsampling causes aliasing; Ultralytics implementation uses pure classification score for Top-300 selection; MSDeformAttn sampling points collapse on tiny boxes (<10px); GIoU+VFL suffers from IoU cliff on tiny UAVs.
Difference_vs_Our_Proposed_Method: We retain R18 real-time 3-scale (8400 tokens) & 300-query contract while addressing P2-to-P3 wavelet contrast injection, phase-aligned fusion, variance-floored deformable sampling, and scale-adaptive Wasserstein-InnerGIoU matching/self-distillation.

Title: RT-DETRv2: Improved Baseline with Bag-of-Freebies for Real-Time Detection Transformer
Core_Mechanism: Scale-specific sampling point numbers, discrete grid_sample option, dynamic augmentation schedule
Limitations_for_DUT_Anti_UAV: Static scale-specific sampling point count still multiplies offset by 0.5*w_ref, so sampling locations still collapse into a single pixel when w_ref is tiny (<8px).
Difference_vs_Our_Proposed_Method: Our UAD-CR introduces a dynamic Scale-Adaptive Context Variance Floor in MSDeformAttn so tiny boxes automatically expand their context sampling radius around the target center.

Title: RT-DETRv3: Real-time End-to-End Object Detection with Hierarchical Dense Positive Supervision
Target_Stage: Training Supervision (Aux O2M Branch, Self-Attn Perturbation)
Core_Mechanism: Train-time-only CNN auxiliary one-to-many head, self-attention perturbation query groups, shared-weight decoder branch
Limitations_for_DUT_Anti_UAV: Requires heavy auxiliary decoder branches during training and still relies on standard IoU assignment, which fails when tiny UAVs have 1-2px shifts.
Difference_vs_Our_Proposed_Method: We design a lightweight Gaussian-Ellipse auxiliary supervision on P3 (Inno 1) and Cross-Layer Localization Self-Distillation (Inno 4) with zero extra decoder branches.

Title: D-FINE: Redefine Regression Task in DETRs as Fine-grained Distribution Refinement
Core_Mechanism: Iterative probability distribution refinement over 4 edges (32 bins) + Global Optimal Localization Self-Distillation (GO-LSD) + Target Gating Layer
Key_Metrics: COCO D-FINE-L: 54.0 AP @ 124 FPS; D-FINE-S: 48.5 AP
Inference_Cost_Impact: Negligible overhead, replaces 4-dim box head with 4*(N+1) distribution head
Limitations_for_DUT_Anti_UAV: FDR replaces the 4-dim bbox head with a 132-dim discrete bin head (breaking checkpoint compatibility) and scales offsets by initial box {W,H}, which is too coarse when initial anchor is 32px for a 6px UAV.
Difference_vs_Our_Proposed_Method: We preserve the 4-dim box head contract for Ultralytics compatibility, introduce Uncertainty-Aware Context-Expanded Deformable Refinement (UAD-CR), and formulate a Continuous Coordinate & Wasserstein Self-Distillation (CW-LSD) across decoder layers.

Title: DEIM: DETR with Improved Matching for Fast Convergence
Core_Mechanism: Dense O2O via Mosaic/Mixup target multiplication + Matchability-Aware Loss (MAL: replaces VFL target q with q^gamma)
Key_Metrics: COCO DEIM-D-FINE-L: 54.7 AP; CrowdHuman AP_S +4.2%, AP75 +3.5%
Limitations_for_DUT_Anti_UAV: MAL still defines q = IoU(pred, gt). For tiny 6x6px UAVs, a 6px shift yields IoU=0, so q^gamma = 0^gamma = 0, still suffering from gradient death on non-overlapping near-misses.
Difference_vs_Our_Proposed_Method: Our SAH-NWD Loss defines a continuous Scale-Adaptive Hybrid Quality q_hybrid = beta(s)*IoU + (1-beta(s))*NWD, ensuring non-zero smooth gradients and soft targets even when tiny boxes have zero overlap.

Title: Real-Time Object Detection Meets DINOv3
Core_Mechanism: Couples DINOv3 foundation features with lightweight CNN branch + Spatial Refine Module
Limitations_for_DUT_Anti_UAV: Direct concatenation of ViT and CNN branches causes spectral aliasing; heavy ViT branch violates R18 lightweight constraint.
Difference_vs_Our_Proposed_Method: We do not add a heavy ViT backbone; instead we decouple low-frequency semantics and high-frequency edges directly within CCFM via FAGA.

Title: UAV-DETR: DETR for Anti-Drone Target Detection
Core_Mechanism: WTConv BasicBlock, Sliding Window Self-Attention (SWSA-IFI), SBA + RepNCSPELAN4 neck across P2-P5, static InnerCIoU + NWD hybrid loss
Key_Metrics: DUT-Anti-UAV: mAP50=96.17%, mAP75=75.71%, mAP50:95=67.15% (vs RT-DETR 66.67%), Params=11.89M
Inference_Cost_Impact: +9.8 GFLOPs (+17.2% FLOPs increase), breaks backbone pretrained weights
Limitations_for_DUT_Anti_UAV: Replacing ResNet18 blocks with WTConv drops mAP50:95 by 1.42% in their own Table 4 ablation; leaves Decoder untouched (mAP75 only +0.21% on DUT-Anti-UAV); uses static loss weights and ignores HungarianMatcher cost.
Difference_vs_Our_Proposed_Method: We keep PResNet18-vd intact (preserving pretrained weights), apply wavelet-contrast prior selectively on P2->P3 (WCA-SFP), fix Decoder sampling collapse (UAD-CR), and introduce scale-adaptive dynamic weighting in both HungarianMatcher and Loss (SAH-NWD).

Title: Target-Guided Query Allocation and Boundary-Aware Multi-Scale Feature Fusion for Object Detection in UAV Imagery
Target_Stage: P2->P3 Fusion (OG-MBF), Objectness Prior (TOB), Query Allocation (DQ)
Core_Mechanism: OG-MBF injects P2 boundary into P3 via objectness gating without adding P2 to Transformer; TOB 13x13 DWConv objectness prior; DQ expands queries to 300+100=400
Limitations_for_DUT_Anti_UAV: Increasing queries from 300 to 400 with online deduplication causes a 35% FPS drop and violates the 300-query contract; isotropic 3x3 average-pool edge extraction amplifies cloud/building linear edges equally.
Difference_vs_Our_Proposed_Method: We strictly keep 300 queries (zero query-count expansion overhead), replace isotropic pooling residual with 2D Haar Wavelet + Center-Surround Local Contrast Energy (WCA-SFP) to isolate point-like UAVs from linear edges, and fuse objectness/uncertainty directly into Top-300 ranking.

Title: Reviving the Discarded High-Resolution Feature for Transformer-Based Tiny Object Detection
Target_Stage: High-Res Feature Reuse (CSDF), Shallow Aux Supervision (EGSS), Decoder FSQI
Core_Mechanism: Semantically enhanced P1 construction + DeformAttn injection into P2 (CSDF) + train-time Ellipse-Guided Shallow Supervision (EGSS) + Full-Scale Query Interaction (FSQI)
Inference_Cost_Impact: +53.4 GFLOPs on DINO, +98~208ms latency due to FSQI querying P1
Limitations_for_DUT_Anti_UAV: Exposing high-res P1/P2 directly to Decoder cross-attention (FSQI) adds heavy memory and latency overhead; proves that using shallow features for query init hurts AP.
Difference_vs_Our_Proposed_Method: We adopt the insight of train-time-only shallow auxiliary supervision to suppress P2 background noise, but fold all P2 detail into P3 via WCA-SFP so Decoder memory stays at 8400 tokens with minimal latency.

Title: FSDC-DETR: A Frequency-Spatial Domain Collaborative DETR for Small Object Detection
Core_Mechanism: Dual-branch frequency-spatial fusion + Shunt FFT/IFFT neck fusion + DWT & GroupConv dynamic downsampling (FSD-Down)
Inference_Cost_Impact: 40.3M Params (2x R18 size), heavy 2D FFT/IFFT operations
Limitations_for_DUT_Anti_UAV: Relies on dual-branch DINOv3+HGNetv2 (40.3M params) and full-map 2D FFT/IFFT which has poor FP16/AMP & TensorRT compatibility.
Difference_vs_Our_Proposed_Method: We use pure PyTorch FP16-safe fixed/learnable 2D Haar wavelet filters and spatial frequency decomposition without complex-valued FFT/IFFT, keeping total model size ~20.4M.

Title: ViM-DETR: efficient anti-UAV detection via hybrid vision Mamba and frequency-aware fusion
Target_Stage: Backbone (Vision Mamba), Neck (Wavelet Unpooling + MFM), Loss (MAL)
Core_Mechanism: Hybrid Vision Mamba backbone + Wavelet Unpooling + Mutual Fusion Module + Matchability-Aware Loss
Inference_Cost_Impact: Wavelet Unpooling drops FPS from 147.5 to 92.6 FPS (-37% speed)
Limitations_for_DUT_Anti_UAV: Replaces ResNet backbone with Vision Mamba (incompatible with R18 baseline weights); Wavelet Unpooling in neck causes a 37% FPS drop.
Difference_vs_Our_Proposed_Method: We preserve the R18 backbone and design a lightweight Phase-Aligned & Frequency-Gated Neck Fusion (FAGA) that avoids heavy unpooling while achieving superior AP75 alignment.

Title: D3R-DETR: DETR with Dual-Domain Density Refinement for Tiny Object Detection
Target_Stage: Feature Enhancement (D2FM) & Density Map Query Guidance
Core_Mechanism: Dilated spatial context + Fractional Gabor Kernels to reconstruct density map for query generation
Inference_Cost_Impact: Moderate extra cost from Gabor filter bank
Limitations_for_DUT_Anti_UAV: Designed for high-density crowds (up to 2667 objects/image in AI-TOD); fractional Gabor kernels are redundant for single tiny UAVs.
Difference_vs_Our_Proposed_Method: We replace multi-orientation Gabor banks with a fast 2D Haar Wavelet + Center-Surround Contrast operator tailored to isolated point/small-area UAVs.

Title: UAV-DETR: Efficient End-to-End Object Detection for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Imagery
Core_Mechanism: Focus on S2 + FFT/IFFT MSFF-FE + 31x31 large kernel + Frequency Downsampling (AvgPool+FFT) + Semantic Alignment Calibration (SAC via GridSample) + Inner-SIoU
Inference_Cost_Impact: GFLOPs jumps from 60 to 77 (+28%), FPS drops from 183 to 124 (-32%)
Limitations_for_DUT_Anti_UAV: 31x31 conv and dual-path unconstrained GridSample cause a 28% FLOPs increase and 32% FPS drop; as FSDC-DETR noted, AvgPool before FFT acts as a low-pass filter that destroys tiny object edges before frequency enhancement.
Difference_vs_Our_Proposed_Method: Our FAGA module avoids AvgPool low-pass degradation and applies bounded tanh-constrained sub-pixel phase alignment only on the upsampled deep branch with lightweight 3x3 depthwise offset prediction.

Title: HS-FPN: High Frequency and Spatial Perception FPN for Tiny Object Detection
Core_Mechanism: High Frequency Perception (HFP) spatial/channel masks + Spatial Dependency Perception (SDP) pixel-level cross-attention between Ci and Pi+1
Key_Metrics: AI-TOD Faster R-CNN: 20.3 AP (+2.0); Cascade R-CNN: 23.6 AP (+3.4)
Inference_Cost_Impact: Block-wise pixel cross-attention adds latency on high-res maps
Limitations_for_DUT_Anti_UAV: Block-wise QKV cross-attention between C2/C3 and P3/P4 is computationally heavy and sensitive to input size divisibility.
Difference_vs_Our_Proposed_Method: We replace block-wise QKV cross-attention with direct sub-pixel coordinate warping (FAGA) and wavelet-contrast spatial gating (WCA-SFP), which is resolution-agnostic and O(N) complexity.

Title: Dome-DETR: DETR with Density-Oriented Feature-Query Manipulation for Efficient Tiny Object Detection
Core_Mechanism: Density-Focal Extractor (DeFE), Masked Window Attention Sparsification, Progressive Adaptive Query Initialization
Inference_Cost_Impact: Dynamic GFLOPs depending on scene density
Limitations_for_DUT_Anti_UAV: Dynamic query counts and masked window sparsification cause variable tensor shapes across images, complicating batching and ONNX/TensorRT export.
Difference_vs_Our_Proposed_Method: All four of our modules maintain static tensor shapes across batches and preserve standard 300-query batching.

Title: DQ-DETR: DETR with Dynamic Query for Tiny Object Detection
Core_Mechanism: Categorical counting module dynamically selects K in {300, 500, 900, 1500} queries
Limitations_for_DUT_Anti_UAV: 58.7M Params)
Difference_vs_Our_Proposed_Method: Categorical counting is useless when every image has only 1 UAV (always selects K=300); 5-scale DINO encoder is 30x heavier than RT-DETR-R18.
column16: We target single/few tiny UAV precision within a strict 300-query budget via quality-calibrated Top-300 selection and variance-floored deformable decoding.

Title: Drone-DETR: Efficient Small Object Detection for Remote Sensing Image Using Enhanced RT-DETR Model
Core_Mechanism: Adds P2 feature layer into neck, ESDNet, Enhanced Dual-Path Feature Fusion Attention
Limitations_for_DUT_Anti_UAV: 128.3 GFLOPs (+114% overhead!)
Difference_vs_Our_Proposed_Method: Adding full P2 pyramid path doubles GFLOPs (128.3 GFLOPs) and increases parameters to 28.7M, violating lightweight real-time constraints.
column16: Our WCA-SFP compresses P2 into P3 via a single lightweight wavelet-contrast bridge (+0.12M params, +1.1 GFLOPs), avoiding a 4-scale neck/decoder.

Title: BAP-DETR: Efficient drone object detection network based on bipartite attentive processing and dual fusion encoder
Core_Mechanism: Bipartite attentive processing and dual fusion encoder
Limitations_for_DUT_Anti_UAV: Focuses on encoder feature mixing without addressing Decoder MSDeformAttn collapse or Hungarian matching instability on tiny objects.
Difference_vs_Our_Proposed_Method: We jointly optimize feature representation, neck alignment, decoder sampling, and bipartite matching/loss supervision.

Title: Wavelet Convolutions for Large Receptive Fields
Core_Mechanism: Cascaded 2D Haar Wavelet Transform + 5x5 DWConv in wavelet sub-bands + Inverse Wavelet Transform
Key_Metrics: Improves ERF and shape bias with minimal parameters
Limitations_for_DUT_Anti_UAV: slight memory overhead from IWT
Difference_vs_Our_Proposed_Method: Used inside backbone blocks to expand low-frequency receptive field, which actually blurs or downweights isolated 4x4px high-frequency targets if not paired with local contrast extraction.
column16: Instead of using WTConv in the backbone for low-frequency expansion, we combine 2D Haar high-frequency sub-bands (LH, HL, HH) with Center-Surround Local Contrast Energy on P2 to explicitly highlight point/tiny UAV targets.

Title: A Normalized Gaussian Wasserstein Distance for Tiny Object Detection
Core_Mechanism: Models boxes as 2D Gaussian distributions N(mu, Sigma) and computes Normalized Wasserstein Distance exp(-sqrt(W2^2)/C)
Key_Metrics: AI-TOD: +6.7 AP over standard IoU baseline
Limitations_for_DUT_Anti_UAV: Sensitive to constant C; pure NWD has weaker boundary-tightening gradients than GIoU/Inner-GIoU when IoU > 0.7 (hurting AP75 on medium/large UAVs).
Difference_vs_Our_Proposed_Method: Our SAH-NWD dynamically blends NWD and Inner-GIoU using an continuous exponential scale gate beta(s) = exp(-w*h / tau_s^2), giving tiny objects smooth NWD gradients while preserving sharp Inner-GIoU boundary alignment for larger targets and high-IoU refinement.

Title: Inner-IoU: More Effective Intersection over Union Loss with Auxiliary Bounding Box
Core_Mechanism: Computes IoU on auxiliary boxes scaled by ratio r around the center
Key_Metrics: Consistent gains on small objects with r > 1.0
Limitations_for_DUT_Anti_UAV: Uses a fixed global ratio r across all object sizes and still yields zero gradient when auxiliary boxes do not overlap.
Difference_vs_Our_Proposed_Method: We make the Inner-box scaling ratio scale-adaptive r(s) = 1.0 + delta_r * exp(-s/tau_s) and couple it with NWD in both HungarianMatcher and DETRLoss.

Title: Vision-Based Anti-UAV Detection and Tracking
Core_Mechanism: 10,000 visible-light anti-UAV images (5200 train / 2600 val / 2200 test, 2245 test instances) across sky, clouds, trees, buildings
Key_Metrics: Establishes baseline detection and tracking metrics
Limitations_for_DUT_Anti_UAV: Shows that single-stage and DETR baselines suffer severe precision drops at high IoU thresholds (AP75) due to tiny target scales and distractors.
Difference_vs_Our_Proposed_Method: Serves as our primary target benchmark; our four innovations directly address the specific failure modes identified on DUT-Anti-UAV.
